templates.distill: Extract a concise, source-grounded chain of reasoning from the supplied passage. Preserve uncertainty and do not introduce facts. Return JSON with a reasoning string. Source ID: {source_id}. Source: {source}
templates.synth: Write a concise, source-grounded reasoning trace using the source and the supplied distilled reasoning. Preserve uncertainty and do not introduce facts. Return JSON with a reasoning string. Source ID: {source_id}. Source: {source}. Distilled reasoning: {reasoning}
